messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Hosted API (us-west-2) p99 latency spike detected. queue_length=4320 (+12x), provisioner_errors > 100/min. Auto-scale attempts failing. Paging on-call.

zoe: seeing 500s and timeouts from our synthetic probes. p95 went from ~180ms -> 2.3s, p99 ~15s. Lots of customer 429/504s reported.

devon: digging in — GPU pool is saturated. Provisioner is returning 429s when creating instances: 'CreateInstance failed: QuotaExceeded' and also intermittent 'rate_limit' from cloud provider. Autoscaler keeps retrying and getting throttled.

sre-kai: @devon paste recent provisioner logs?

devon: logs snippet:
```
2026-02-20T14:07:48Z provisioner INFO request create -> payload {gpu_type: v100, preemptible: false}
2026-02-20T14:07:49Z provisioner WARN create failed status=429 body="QuotaExceeded: Insufficient GPU quota"
2026-02-20T14:08:03Z autoscaler INFO scale_loop attempt=3 target_pool=hosted-usw-1
2026-02-20T14:08:04Z autoscaler ERROR scale failed err=provisioner_quota_throttle retrying
```

zoe: customers hitting timeouts are mostly medium-sized multi-tenant apps (not huge single tenant). Impact profiled at ~4.7% of total requests currently failing, error rate x5.

support-lucas: just opened a ticket with Customer A complaining about 504s hitting search endpoint. Escalating to account team.

eng-oncall: quick ask — can we fallback to a smaller model variant (cpu/half-precision) to relieve GPU pressure?

devon: we have fallback model m-lite available in eu-west and us-east, but us-west routing is sticky. We can enable cross-region routing but that will add ~80-120ms latency for affected customers.

sre-kai: immediate mitigation plan:
- block autoscaler from retrying noisy creates (set autoscaler.retry_backoff=30s)
- manually increase provisioner burst for hosted-usw pool (override burst_limit -> 4)
- enable model fallback for non-SLA routes (route low-priority traffic to m-lite)
- bring up temporary dedicated machines from reserved pool (if available)

zoe: how long to apply overrides?

devon: I can flip the provisioner burst override in ~2 minutes. Autoscaler tweak requires a deploy — I'll patch and roll a small config change (canary to 10% first).

sre-kai: I'll coordinate handoff. @eng-oncall please standby for followups, I'll take primary after devon changes.

incident-bot: Pager acknowledged by sre-kai.

(devon made config change)
devon: provisioner burst override applied -> burst_limit=4. Observed create success rate improved from 15% -> 78% within first 40s.

sre-kai: good, queue drain has started. current queue_length=2300 -> down from 4320. p99 dropping slowly.

eng-oncall: rolling fallback routes for low-priority traffic now (20% of requests). That should reduce GPU token issuance by ~30%.

support-lucas: informing affected customers that we're mitigating and expect recovery in ~15-30min.

zoe: running quick BLR (business impact) calc: baseline QPS ~55k, currently about 2.6k RPS queued. That backlog caused ~1200 504s in last 10m. We should mark this incident as customer-impacting.

sre-kai: agreed. Severity = Sev2 (widespread errors, degraded SLAs).

(devon) paste of autoscaler metrics after change:
```
14:12:00 autoscaler.scaling_attempts=58
14:12:00 provisioner.create_success_rate=0.78
14:12:00 hosted-usw.gpu_util=98%
14:12:00 hosted-usw.queue_len=1840
```

zoe: any blockers left?

devon: cloud provider quota request is pending — submitted emergency quota increase but ETA unknown (support case open). If provider doesn't fulfill, we should keep fallbacks and consider routing more traffic to eu-west.

sre-kai: action items (assigned):
- devon: monitor provisioner success and autoscaler behavior, revert retry flood -> IN PROGRESS
- eng-oncall: keep fallback routing in place, validate correctness -> IN PROGRESS
- zoe: update status page and customer comms (ETA 30m) -> IN PROGRESS
- support-lucas: list top impacted customers and notify account owners -> IN PROGRESS

(15m later)
eng-oncall: queue length now 410, p95 ~ 210ms, p99 ~ 1.8s. Error rate returning toward baseline.

support-lucas: customer updates sent; one enterprise account requested an SLA credit; routing team flagged for follow-up.

sre-kai: handing off to eng-oncall for post-mortem and follow-up. I'll continue monitoring for 1hr then clear pager.

eng-oncall: taking over. Logged incident ticket INC-2026-0402 with timeline and mitigation steps. Will run retrospective to identify: quota monitoring gaps, autoscaler backoff tuning, cross-region spill plan.

zoe: post-incident notes — consider automatic soft-failover to m-lite for non-critical endpoints when pool utilization > 85%, and surface quota consumption to the console for admins.

incident-bot: Incident resolved (conditions: queue_len < 500 and p99 < 2s) at 1708502765.

sre-kai: leaving one note — provisioner should treat 429 QuotaExceeded as a hard-fail for a short window (avoid hammering cloud APIs). I'll add that to the retro action list.

— end of thread —
